statement: Merge snapshot backfill batches rows like split does: applyMergeSnapshotRow's per-row INSERT OR REPLACE (one routed write per row, one descriptor-epoch assert per row) is replaced by a bounded multi-row batch path mirroring routeSplitSnapshotBatch (SPLIT_SNAPSHOT_MAX_BIND_VARIABLES-capped values tuples, one epoch assert per batch, the same yield cadence), so a large merge backfill stops paying per-row round-trips. doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/merge-backfill-batching.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — batched-merge-backfill, bind-variable-cap-respected, and epoch-assert-per-batch receipts all passing.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Each new regression test must fail when the corresponding mechanism is reverted while the rest of the change remains.
The oracle evidence files must be written by a deterministic evidence harness that re-runs the recorded proof commands (focused test files, red-on-revert probes) and writes the receipt artifact.
Batching must not reorder rows or skip the backfill yield cadence (F22): rows land in primary-key order within and across batches, and splitSnapshotBackfillYieldEveryRows still paces the copy.
